notes:
URL-pre-filter workaround on a SuccessFactors board — same platform and same shape as Coloplast and Terumo BCT. Costa Rica is carried by the SuccessFactors country facet ?optionsFacetsDD_country=CR; the board reports 'Results 1 - 6 of 6, Page 1 of 1', so the filtered set is complete and single-page. All six rows are Costa Rica sites (CR1 Heredia, CR2 Coyol, CR3 Cartago, Plaza Roble Escazu).

Prefix: job URLs are /job/<Title-with-location>/<id>/, so derive_path_prefix on any sample returns a per-job title path and LinkRule(path_prefix='/job') is required — the same override Coloplast and Terumo carry.

hooks.filter_already_applied=True guards the pre-applied filter against the agent driving the board's own search inputs; with it the live run settles in 3 steps. expected_unfiltered_count=6 is unfiltered relative to the ship-path URL, not the full board.

Handle note: 'boston' resolves to Boston Consulting Group, which sits earlier in COMPANIES and wins under the catalog's insertion-order substring match, so this entry ships explicit aliases ('bostonsci', 'bsci'). The queue's original sample_job_url (.../Quality-Assurance-Engineer-III-Temporary-12-months-A/1410268200/) had closed by integration time and is absent from the filtered set; a live posting is shipped instead, though the explicit path_prefix makes the derivation moot either way.
